Hello, I’m CIRA, the Clinical Intake and Risk Assessment assistant at St. Michael’s Hospital, Unity Health Toronto. I’ll collect some information before your appointment.

What is your full legal name as it appears on your legal documents?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think it’s Angela Smith.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, that’s my full legal name.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.message: Yes, I do.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your family doctor’s full name, including their first and last name?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think it’s Dr. Reid… or maybe Dr. Marcus Reid?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Could you confirm your family doctor’s full name? Is it **Dr. Marcus Reid**, or do you know the doctor’s first name?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Dr. Marcus Reid.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you currently have a psychiatrist?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I don’t.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What main problems or difficulties have you been experiencing lately? Please describe what happens, where it occurs, and any specific consequences.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’ve been feeling really down and kind of irritable, and there’s just no pleasure in anything lately. I end up pacing around the house and snapping at my family. It’s been hard on everyone.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What do you hope to get out of your appointment? Please include anything else you would like help with.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Mostly I just want someone to talk to and to feel better.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been assessed by a mental health professional?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think so, maybe once before with someone in outpatient care… do you mean a psychiatrist or just any mental health professional?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Yes—this includes any mental health professional, such as a psychiatrist, psychologist, therapist, or social worker. Do you remember when this assessment happened and who conducted it?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It was in 2025, with an outpatient psychiatrist.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever received a psychiatric diagnosis, such as depression, anxiety, OCD, or bipolar disorder?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Depression, I think.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: When you say depression, do you mean that a mental health professional diagnosed you with depression, or are you unsure?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, a mental health professional diagnosed me with depression.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further psychiatric diagnoses you’re aware of?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health reasons?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I haven’t.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever thought about or tried to intentionally hurt yourself?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’m not sure if you mean recently or ever before—could you clarify?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: I mean at any time in your life, including recently: have you ever thought about or tried to intentionally hurt yourself?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I haven’t intentionally hurt myself.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever received CBT, DBT, Interpersonal Therapy, Mindfulness-Based Therapy, Psychodynamic Therapy, or another type of therapy?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, I’ve had supportive psychotherapy.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: When did you receive the supportive psychotherapy?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It was in 2025.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Approximately how many sessions did you attend?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: About 3 sessions.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Where did you receive the supportive psychotherapy?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t really remember where exactly, just that it was outpatient.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Was it at a hospital outpatient clinic, a community mental health clinic, or a private therapist’s office?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’m not sure which one, honestly. Outpatient somewhere.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further therapies you’ve received?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever received rTMS, ECT, Deep Brain Stimulation, ketamine treatment, or another biological treatment?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I haven’t.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are you currently taking any prescribed medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I’m not on any right now.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you previously tried any psychiatric medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, I have. I was on one antidepressant before.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What was the name of the antidepressant?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Fluoxetine.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What dose of fluoxetine were you taking?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: 20 mg daily.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: When did you start fluoxetine, and when did you stop—or approximately how long did you take it?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I took it for about 6 weeks in 2025.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What was the reason you stopped taking fluoxetine?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think it was because it didn’t suit me very well… I had some side effects, if that’s what you mean.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Could you tell me a little more specifically why you stopped—for example, which side effects or problems led you to discontinue it?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: It made me really fatigued.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Were there any other psychiatric medications you previously tried?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever been diagnosed with any medical conditions?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, nothing that I know of.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever had any surgical procedures?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I haven’t had any surgeries.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your height? Please provide it in centimetres or feet and inches.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think I know it, but I’m a bit fuzzy—do you want it in centimetres or feet and inches?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Either format is fine. What is your height in centimetres, or in feet and inches?

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is your weight? Please provide it in kilograms or pounds.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: About 59 kg.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Do you have any known allergies to medications?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I don’t have any medication allergies.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have any of your family members been diagnosed with a mental health condition, such as depression, anxiety, OCD, bipolar disorder, or schizophrenia?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Yes, I think my mother has recurrent depression. And my older brother has anxiety.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any further family members with mental health conditions?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, those are all.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Apart from alcohol used as part of prescribed medical treatment—which generally does not apply—have you ever used alcohol recreationally or outside medical treatment: never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Previously, but none since pregnancy.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Apart from prescribed nicotine replacement or other medical treatment, have you ever used cigarettes, vaping products, or other nicotine products—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.message: Apart from any prescribed medication taken as directed, have you ever used marijuana or cannabis—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.message: Apart from any stimulant prescribed to you and taken as directed, have you ever used stimulants nonmedically—such as cocaine, methamphetamine, MDMA, or ecstasy—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.message: I’m not really sure what you mean by stimulants there—do you mean things like cocaine or meth?

conversation.message: Yes, exactly—cocaine, methamphetamine, MDMA or ecstasy, and similar nonmedical stimulant substances. Have you ever used any of these: never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Never.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Apart from any opioid or narcotic prescribed to you and taken as directed, have you ever used opioids or narcotics nonmedically—such as someone else’s prescription, or more than prescribed—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Never.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Apart from any benzodiazepine prescribed to you and taken as directed, have you ever used benzodiazepines nonmedically—such as Valium, Ativan, or Xanax—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Have you ever used hallucinogens nonmedically—such as LSD, PCP, or psilocybin—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Never.

conversation.message: Have you ever used any other substances nonmedically that we have not discussed—never, previously, or currently?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Never.

conversation.message: Are you currently involved in any active legal cases?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: No, I’m not.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: What is the highest level of education you have completed?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think I went through school up to high school, but I’m a little fuzzy on how you’d want it recorded.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Could you tell me about your recent employment history? For each recent job, please include the employer or organization, job title, and start and end dates or approximate duration.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Sure — I worked at Westgate Department Store as a retail sales associate from 2010 to 2013, and after that I’ve been a homemaker since 2013.

conversation.speaker: CIRA

conversation.speaker: PATIENT

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please describe your early childhood, including where you were born, where you grew up, and what you were like as a young child.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I was born and grew up, and that’s about all I really know to say there.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Could you tell me the places where you were born and grew up, and how you would describe yourself as a young child—for example, shy, outgoing, sensitive, or energetic?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t really know the specific places, and I’m not sure how I was as a young child.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please describe your adolescence and early adulthood, including your experience in school, any difficulties you experienced, jobs or responsibilities you had, and any other important experiences you would like to share.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I think there may have been some childhood depression, and my parents divorced. That’s the main thing I remember.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Please describe the significant relationships in your life, including family and friendships, as well as any romantic partnerships. You may mention the type of relationship, approximate dates or duration, and whether it is current or ended.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’m married, and it’s been about 13 years. We have children too. My husband can be pretty critical, which makes things harder at home.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Are there any other significant relationships you would like to mention, such as family members or close friends?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I’m not sure if you mean family or friends in particular. I probably should think about that a bit more.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: That’s okay. You can include any family members or close friends who have been especially important to you, or let me know if there are none you wish to mention.

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I don’t have anything else specific to add right now.

conversation.speaker: CIRA
conversation.message: Thank you. What goals would you like to work toward in the future, such as related to your health, education, employment, relationships, family, or personal development?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: I want to feel like myself again and be there for my family.
